On the 15th floor of the Hotel New Akao Main Building (now Ocean Wing), a long-established resort hotel in Atami that was recently renovated, there is a multi-purpose hall called "Salon de Kinrin."
Hotel New Akao: Completed/1972, Design/Inaba Choji Architectural Office, Construction/Shimizu Corporation, Renovated/2023. It seems Salon de Kinrin was once used as a dance hall.
Upon entering the room, one is struck by the vivid blue colonnade finished in stone that stands before the panoramic ocean view.
